newsitem.title: FRANCE: L'Oreal inaugurates first China factory.
newsitem.headline: L'Oreal inaugurates first China factory.

text.p: French cosmetics giant L'Oreal said on Monday that it had inaugurated its first Chinese factory in Suzhou, 80 km west of Shanghai, as part of a strategy to gain a strong position in the Chinese market.
"This production facility is intended to manufacture make-up and skin-care products under the Maybelline brand," the company said in a statement.

It plans to build a second Chinese factory, also in Suzhou, that will be incorporated into the Suzhou L'Oreal Beauty Products Co Ltd, which is 95 percent controlled by L'Oreal and five percent by the Suzhou Medical College.
